newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rupiah steady, focus on liquidity, swaps.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rupiah steady, focus on liquidity, swaps.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was steady against the dollar in late trading on Thursday, with the focus seen on liquidity and short-dated swaps, dealers said.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,405.00/05.30 at 1020 GMT compared with an opening of 2,405.00/06.00.
"Short-dated swaps, especially the two-week swap, were in strong demand due to the fiscal year-end on March 31," one foreign bank dealer said.
He said the sharp difference between the one-week and two-week swap reflected higher demand for the annual tax payments at the fiscal year-end.
